description: Manage audio device routing: list all input and output devices, get the current default input and output devices, or switch the default input or output device. Device names support case-insensitive partial matching — "MacBook" matches "MacBook Pro Microphone". Volume level control is separate (use macos_control_volume). Requires SwitchAudioSource CLI (brew install switchaudio-osx).

action.description: list — all devices; current — default input and output; switch_output/switch_input — change the default device.

device.description: Partial or full device name for switch_output/switch_input. Case-insensitive substring match.

type.description: Filter by device type for action=list. Defaults to "all".

name: macos_control_audio

device.description: The device that is now the default. Present for switch actions.

devices.description: All audio devices matching the type filter. Present for action=list.

id.description: Device identifier (matches device name for SwitchAudioSource).

is_default.description: True when this is the current default device for its type.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `device_not_found`: No audio device name matches the provided string. `switchaudio_unavailable`: SwitchAudioSource CLI is not installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

input.description: Current default input device. Present for action=current.

output.description: Current default output device. Present for action=current.

success.description: True when the switch completed. Present for switch actions.

title: Control macOS Audio Routing
